description:
Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Customer harassment ("kasuhara") occurs when workers face unreasonable demands from customers, are blamed repeatedly, or experience other conduct that harms their work environment.

To help everyone work safely, support stable business operations, and enable people to enjoy secure consumer lives, Saitama Prefecture has enacted an ordinance that defines the responsibilities of all parties involved.

Ahead of the ordinance's implementation, the prefecture is undertaking the following initiatives:

• Publishing guides for businesses and business groups to develop basic policies and response manuals
• Dispatching customer harassment prevention consultants to businesses (recruitment begins May 7)
• Hosting online seminars on customer harassment prevention (now recruiting)

For more details, visit the link below.

■ Saitama Prefecture Customer Harassment Prevention Measures

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2576/
